system.description:
The Exalted who ventures beyond the borders of Creation must learn to read the subtle wrongness of places where chaos has touched the world. Activating this charm, the Solar heightens her instincts to perceive Wyld taint, mutations, and the telltale instabilities that mark territory touched by chaos. She can detect the presence and rough intensity of Wyld influence within (Perception + Survival) × 10 yards, identifying mutated creatures, tainted locations, and zones where reality has become malleable.

The charm also grants two bonus dice to all Survival rolls made in or near Wyld-tainted areas, as the Solar's heightened awareness lets her navigate chaos-touched terrain safely. Locations where the Wyld influence is strong enough to cause immediate mutation or reality distortion are sensed with enough warning to allow evasive action. This charm is the prerequisite for Outland Navigating Guile.
